b1-36-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Meeting
b1-36-01.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks how the meeting at your office in Budapest went this morning. You arrived late: the meeting had already started. Afterwards you talked with your colleagues and understood the plan.
b1-36-01.prompt: Tell Meg what happened, in order.
cues: Say what had already happened when you arrived
b1-36-01.target: Cuando llegué, ya había empezado la reunión. Después de hablar con mis compañeros, entendí el plan.
b1-36-01.english: When I arrived, the meeting had already started. After talking with my colleagues, I understood the plan.
b1-36-01.canDo: I can tell a connected story using familiar B1 narrative structures.

b1-36-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Online Lessons
b1-36-02.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos suggests taking your Spanish lessons online because it is cheaper. You understand the argument, but you do not think it is the best option, and you are convinced that you need to speak with people.
b1-36-02.prompt: Tell Carlos your position and why.
cues: Say what you do not think
Say what you are convinced of
b1-36-02.target: No creo que sea la mejor opción, aunque entiendo el argumento. Estoy convencida de que necesito hablar con personas.
b1-36-02.english: I don't think it is the best option, although I understand the argument. I am convinced that I need to talk with people.
b1-36-02.canDo: I can explain and defend a position.

b1-36-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Problem at the Office
b1-36-03.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks about a problem at your office in Budapest: some colleagues arrive at the wrong time because nobody tells them the new schedule.
b1-36-03.prompt: Tell Meg the problem, its cause and what is necessary.
cues: Say the cause of the problem
b1-36-03.target: El problema existe porque falta información sobre el horario. Por eso, es necesario que busquemos una solución.
b1-36-03.english: The problem exists because information about the schedule is missing. Therefore, it is necessary that we look for a solution.
b1-36-03.canDo: I can explain a problem and its causes.

b1-36-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Next Year
b1-36-04.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks about your plans for next year. It is possible that you will travel to Madrid. If you had more money, you would also travel to Chile to see Daniela.
b1-36-04.prompt: Tell Carlos what is possible and what you would do with more money.
cues: Say what you would do with more money
b1-36-04.target: Es posible que viaje a Madrid. Si tuviera más dinero, viajaría también a Chile para ver a Daniela.
b1-36-04.english: It is possible that I will travel to Madrid. If I had more money, I would also travel to Chile to see Daniela.
b1-36-04.canDo: I can discuss future possibilities and alternatives.

b1-36-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Marta's Story
b1-36-05.scenario: You are Meg. You read a story about a woman called Marta for your class in Budapest, and Carlos asks what it says. Marta does not think a perfect solution exists, but she thinks it is important to listen to different opinions. In her community, some people arrive late because the transport does not work well.
b1-36-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what Marta thinks and what the problem is.
cues: Say what Marta does not believe
Say the problem in her community
b1-36-05.target: Marta no cree que exista una solución perfecta, pero cree que es importante escuchar diferentes opiniones. En su comunidad, algunas personas llegan tarde porque el transporte no funciona bien.
b1-36-05.english: Marta does not believe that a perfect solution exists, but she believes it is important to listen to different opinions. In her community, some people arrive late because the transport does not work well.
b1-36-05.canDo: I can communicate independently across familiar B1 situations.

b1-36-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Working from Home
b1-36-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks what you think about working from home two days a week at your office in Budapest. You are not sure it is a perfect solution, but you are convinced it can help, and you think you must talk with your boss.
b1-36-consolidation.prompt: Give Meg your opinion and say what is necessary.
cues: Say what you do not believe
Say what you are convinced of
b1-36-consolidation.target: No creo que sea una solución perfecta, pero estoy convencido de que puede ayudar. Es necesario que hablemos con el jefe.
b1-36-consolidation.english: I don't think it is a perfect solution, but I am convinced that it can help. It is necessary that we talk with the boss.
b1-36-consolidation.canDo: I can retrieve the main B1 structures in connected communication.
